content:
# MPM Nested CV Configuration

# Project paths (relative to the project root)
paths:
  original_data: "data/Yilgarn_GIS_DB.csv"
  reference_folds: null

# Output directories (relative to the project root)
output_dirs:
  folds: "outputs/folds"
  optuna: "outputs/optuna"
  models: "outputs/models"
  conformal: "outputs/conformal"
  test_evaluation: "outputs/test_evaluation"
  aggregated: "outputs/aggregated"
  figures: "outputs/figures"
  reports: "reports"

# Data configuration
data:
  target_column: "Ni_mine"
  coordinate_columns: ["TMX", "TMY"]
  feature_columns:
    # Magnetic
    - "TMI"
    - "RTP"
    - "1VD"
    # Geophysical
    - "DGIR"
    - "AuSREM"
    # Proximity
    - "Prox_Ultramafic Source"
    - "Prox_MajorCrustal"
    - "Prox_Fault"
    # Worms
    - "worms_mag_1km"
    - "worms_mag_4.6km"
    - "worms_mag_11km"
    - "worms_mag_50km"
    - "worms_grav_1km"
    - "worms_grav_4.6km"
    - "worms_grav_11km"
    - "worms_grav_50km"
    # Radiometric
    - "K_pct"
    - "Th_ppm"
    - "U_ppm"
    # Age
    - "Tectonic Bedrock Age (MA)"
    - "Interpreted Bedrock Age (MA)"
  proximity_features:
    - "Prox_Ultramafic Source"
    - "Prox_MajorCrustal"
    - "Prox_Fault"
  winsorize_features:
    - "TMI"
    - "RTP"
    - "1VD"
    - "DGIR"
  missing_indicator_threshold: 0.05

# Spatial block CV configuration
spatial_cv:
  block_size_km: 50
  n_outer_folds: 5
  n_inner_folds: 5
  stratify: true
  random_state: 42

# Optuna configuration
optuna:
  n_trials: 30
  sampler: "TPE"
  pruner: "MedianPruner"
  pruner_n_startup_trials: 5
  pruner_n_warmup_steps: 10
  direction: "maximize"
  objective_metric: "pr_auc"
  timeout_seconds: null
  n_jobs: 1

# Bootstrap configuration
bootstrap:
  n_bootstraps: 50
  random_state: 42

# Conformal prediction configuration
conformal:
  alpha: 0.15
  delta: 0.05
  n_iterations: 20

# Zone classification method
zone_method: "jorc30"

# Practical zone modes
practical_zone_modes:
  - "prob"
  - "lift"

# Zone classification thresholds
zone_thresholds:
  # Absolute probability scheme
  jorc30:
    rel_iqr_threshold: 0.30
    prob_z0: 0.50
    prob_z1: 0.25
    prob_z2: 0.10

  # Lift (percentile) scheme
  lift:
    rel_iqr_threshold: 0.30
    lift_z0: 0.01
    lift_z1: 0.05
    lift_z2: 0.10

  # Legacy percentile + std scheme
  percentile_std:
    prob_percentile_high: 98
    prob_percentile_mod: 90
    prob_percentile_low: 70
    std_low: 0.0765
    std_moderate: 0.1020
    std_high: 0.1276

# Zone definitions
zone_definitions:
  0:
    name: "IMMEDIATE"
    description: "prob >= 0.50 AND rel_IQR <= 30%"
    color: "#d62728"
  1:
    name: "PRIORITY"
    description: "high prob OR mid prob with low uncertainty"
    color: "#ff7f0e"
  2:
    name: "FOLLOW_UP"
    description: "mid prob OR low-mid prob with low uncertainty"
    color: "#ffbb78"
  3:
    name: "POTENTIAL"
    description: "remaining in_set_1 samples"
    color: "#2ca02c"
  4:
    name: "EXCLUDED"
    description: "in_set_1 = 0 (conformal excluded)"
    color: "#9467bd"

# Validation criteria
validation_criteria:
  coverage_min: 0.85
  zone_0_1_capture_min: 0.25
  zone_0_1_2_capture_min: 0.40
  zone_4_capture_max: 0.10

# Methods to evaluate
methods:
  - "xgboost"
  - "baggingpu_xgboost"

# Visualization configuration
visualization:
  figure_formats: ["png", "pdf"]
  dpi: 300
  figsize_single: [8, 6]
  figsize_wide: [12, 6]
  figsize_map: [10, 10]
  colormap_prob: "magma"
  colormap_std: "viridis"
  colormap_zone: ["#d62728", "#ff7f0e", "#ffbb78", "#2ca02c", "#9467bd"]

# Logging configuration
logging:
  level: "INFO"
  format: "%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s"
  file_logging: true
  log_dir: "logs"

# Random seeds
random_seeds:
  numpy: 42
  sklearn: 42
  optuna: 42
  bootstrap: 42
